intent: 做一个软件，是批量管理github库的，允许批量添加多个github的文件夹，并且可以批量勾选项目进行更新，提交等操作，还能看到提交的日志树等等

gaps: Need an offline-friendly stack with no external runtime dependencies
Need batch operations without blocking the UI thread
Need a readable git log tree for a selected repository

steps.findings: Chose a Python + Tkinter desktop MVP to keep the app offline-friendly and testable with the standard library.

steps.args: "Build a desktop batch GitHub repository manager with repository import, batch pull/commit/push, and git log tree" -y
steps.findings: Planned four sequential implementation tasks spanning scaffolding, git operations, UI, and tests/docs.
Implemented a Python/Tkinter desktop MVP with repository discovery, persistence, batch git actions, and a log tree panel.

steps.args: "Validate core services and UI integration for the GitHub batch manager" -y
steps.findings: Ran unittest coverage for discovery, store, status parsing, commit flow, and log loading; all tests passed.
